# Md. Shakibur Rahaman - Strategic Lead & Digital Architect & Digital Growth Architect

> Full-Stack Creative Director delivering integrated branding, visual design, web engineering, omnichannel marketing, commercial cinematography, and live experiential activations.

## 9 Core Service Pillars
1. **Branding**: Comprehensive brand strategy, brand positioning, brand architecture, corporate identity manuals, brand guidelines, and tone of voice.
2. **Graphics Design**: Visual identity systems, logo marks, UI/UX interface design, luxury packaging, editorial print, and high-impact marketing collateral.
3. **Web Design & Development**: 15+ live deployed web platforms, headless e-commerce, custom web apps, API architecture, and 95+ PageSpeed performance.
4. **Social Media Marketing (SMM)**: Omnichannel strategy, viral short-form video reels, community growth, and Meta Advantage+ paid scaling.
5. **Photoshoot & Videography**: Commercial broadcast TVCs, cinematic product shoots, brand documentaries, high-retention video reels, and aerial drone cinematography.
6. **Event Activation & Exhibition**: 3D booth design & custom fabrication, B2B trade show installations, corporate galas, and experiential brand activations.
7. **Google Ads**: High-intent Search, Performance Max, YouTube conversion funnels, and granular GA4 multi-touch attribution.
8. **SEO & AEO**: Technical on-page SEO, generative AI engine optimization (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini), /llms.txt context, and Schema.org knowledge graph.
9. **PR (Public Relations)**: Strategic press release distribution, tier-1 media placements, crisis communications, and executive thought leadership.

## 15 Deployed Web Portals
- Hotel Sarina Dhaka (5-Star Luxury Booking & Dining Portal)
- LuxeHaven Interiors (Architectural Design & Fitout Studio)
- Prestige VIP Club (Members-Only Private Concierge)
- GlobalEd Pathways (International Study Abroad Portal)
- Apex Recruitment Hub (Executive Search & B2B Staffing)
- WanderLuxe Expeditions (Premium Travel & Tour Operator)
- Aura Studio Fashion (D2C E-Commerce Flagship Store)
- UrbanBite Gourmet (Artisanal Cloud Kitchen & Delivery)
- NovaPulse SaaS (AI-Powered Social Analytics Dashboard)
- Veritas Law Chambers (Corporate Legal Advisory Firm)
- Zenith Health Clinics (Telemedicine & Appointment Suite)
- Prism Creative Collective (Multimedia Production Agency)
- EstatePrime Properties (High-End Real Estate Portal)
- ChronoCraft Horology (Heritage Luxury Watch Store)
- EchoSound Festival (Live Concert & Event Ticket Engine)

caseStudies.title: Campaign Execution Framework
caseStudies.subtitle: The way how I execute a campaign starting from planning to Result
caseStudies.tagline: The way how I execute a campaign starting from planning to Result
caseStudies.challenge: Scaling ad spend across fragmented paid social and search channels suffered from rapid creative fatigue within 7 days, 35% tracking signal loss from browser privacy updates, and erratic customer acquisition costs.
caseStudies.solution: Architected an end-to-end Campaign Execution Framework unifying 4-tier audience segmentation, modular weekly creative testing sprints, first-party CAPI conversion pipelines, and automated budget pacing governance.

caseStudies.title: Kitchen Cabinet Lead Generation — Campaign Workflow
caseStudies.tagline: Performance-driven lead generation strategy built around a strong market insight, a 7-day completion offer, and targeted video ads.
caseStudies.challenge: The kitchen cabinet market was competitive with businesses offering similar products. Capturing attention and generating leads at scale required standing out from competitors and overcoming low conversion rates.
caseStudies.solution: Introduced a bold 7-day completion offer with high-engagement video ads across Meta (Facebook & Instagram), converting inquiries with streamlined sales qualification.

caseStudies.title: Luxora Furniture - Bespoke Luxury Furniture D2C E-Store
caseStudies.tagline: Headless commerce architecture with custom dynamic 3D wood finish selectors and automated EMI installment ledger.
caseStudies.challenge: High-ticket luxury furniture struggled to convert online due to lack of dynamic material visualization and absence of flexible installment payment methods.
caseStudies.solution: Engineered a headless storefront with ultra-high fidelity variant previewers, custom room dimension calculators, and a multi-month EMI financing tracker.

caseStudies.title: ASAP Interior Solutions - Commercial & Residential Architecture Hub
caseStudies.tagline: Digital flagship for an elite interior architecture firm with 3D walkthrough galleries and automated quotation calculator.
caseStudies.challenge: High-value commercial clients were bouncing because the previous portfolio couldn't showcase complex spatial plans and required manual email back-and-forth for estimates.
caseStudies.solution: Created a sleek glassmorphic portfolio featuring interactive blueprint zooming, instant square-footage estimation tools, and CRM calendar integration.

caseStudies.title: Hotel Sarina Dhaka - 5-Star Direct Booking & Banquet Reservation Suite
caseStudies.tagline: Bypassing OTA commission fees with a sub-second direct guest booking engine, culinary event ticketing, and VIP loyalty portal.
caseStudies.challenge: Over 75% of reservations flowed through third-party OTAs, incurring 18-22% commission fees and creating fragmented guest communication.
caseStudies.solution: Designed and deployed a luxury direct booking platform with live date-picker room availability, banquet event inquiries, and instant SMS voucher delivery.

caseStudies.title: Apex Scaler - Meta & Google Performance Max Ad Architecture
caseStudies.tagline: Multi-touch conversion funnel capturing high-intent search buyers combined with Meta Advantage+ creative remarketing.
caseStudies.challenge: Ad fatigue and skyrocketing CPMs resulted in a sub-par 1.8x ROAS and inconsistent lead volumes on traditional search keywords.
caseStudies.solution: Restructured account taxonomy into intent-segmented Search, Google Performance Max with custom audience signals, and server-side Meta CAPI tracking.

caseStudies.title: Botanica Organics - Luxury Brand Identity, Sustainable Packaging & 3D System
caseStudies.tagline: Building an iconic corporate visual system, tactile minimalist packaging, and 3D digital asset guidelines for premium retail shelves.
caseStudies.challenge: Generic brand visuals failed to communicate organic luxury, resulting in buyer hesitation at high retail price points.
caseStudies.solution: Crafted a bespoke visual identity manual, custom foil-stamped packaging die-lines, and photorealistic 3D bottle renders that command instant prestige.

caseStudies.title: Zenith Health & Telemedicine - Generative AI Engine Optimization (SEO & AEO)
caseStudies.tagline: Dominating both traditional Google search rankings and LLM answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude) through entity graph engineering.
caseStudies.challenge: Zero visibility in new AI search overviews and declining traditional keyword click-through rates as patients migrated to conversational search.
caseStudies.solution: Implemented Schema.org MedicalEntity graphs, standardized /llms.txt content directives, and semantic citation clusters to secure AI answer inclusion.

caseStudies.title: Mega Tech Expo 2025 - Turnkey 3D Exhibition Pavilion & Live Activation
caseStudies.tagline: Designing and fabricating a custom 3D exhibition pavilion with interactive LED touch tunnels, live demos, and experiential branding.
caseStudies.challenge: Standing out among 200+ competing international tech exhibits and capturing high-intent B2B enterprise leads in a loud environment.
caseStudies.solution: Engineered an open-concept architectural pavilion with 3D spatial flow, interactive badge scanning stations, and an immersive LED keynote amphitheater.
